b001.question: Can you tell me about yourself and your background?

en: Walk us through your background.
Give us a quick introduction to who you are.
What's your story so far?

b001.opener: Sure, I'll give you the short version of what I've worked on.
points: I led Lantern, an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices.
Lantern cut manual data entry from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per invoice.
I also built a small route optimiser for a courier pilot that reduced empty runs by 14 percent.
b001.deep: My recent work splits into two projects. The first is Lantern, an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices, which I led. It cut manual data entry from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per invoice and ran on 38,000 invoices a month. The second is a small route optimiser I built for a courier pilot, which reduced empty runs by 14 percent. The pilot ran for 10 weeks across 23 vans in Torino. Together they cover LLM extraction work and route planning.

b003.deep: Lantern is an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices, and I led the project. Extraction is schema-validated with one retry, then escalated; I never let the model guess a total. I chose a small model for the first pass and a larger one only on low-confidence documents.
